verdict.rationale: Netlify is a platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. The only relevant evidence is a single docs line saying users can 'connect AI assistants to your Netlify account', which matches the core of the story but never names MCP or describes a server, its tools, or setup. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that this is an official MCP server, documented setup/transport and tool coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Share context & connect AI assistants to your Netlify account for seamless deployment workflows.
